card.name: Linking words in policy and market group names
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "and" or modifiers inside organization, program or expert titles in energy, markets and policy settings, where a policy, regulation or marketing term is likely next.

modes.label: "and" in policy titles
modes.description: The word "and" joins nouns in a group or legal heading, just before a word like Policy or Revocation.
modes.example: a staff scientist and group leader of the Electricity Markets<< and>> Policy Group at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory,

modes.label: Descriptor before an expert or market term
modes.description: A field word such as energy, market or Financial sits in a job title or company description in business and energy writing.
modes.example: Claudia Kemfert, an<< energy>> expert at the DIW economic think-tank

modes.label: Address and name punctuation
modes.description: Punctuation or spacing after an organization name or in its street address.
modes.example: National Organization for Rare Disorders (NORD<<) >>55 Kenosia Avenue Dan

card.writes: It nudges the next word toward policy, negotiation, marketing and administrative terms, and away from technical and laboratory terms.
